stemMd: In a four-person ordering, all positions1–4 are occupied once. N comes before P. Q comes immediately after N. R is not in position4. In column "first", select the person necessarily in position1. In column "last", select the person necessarily in position4.
instructionsMd: Select exactly one answer in each named column. Both selections must be correct. The project presents separate column lists rather than the official interface’s shared matrix or drop-down controls.
explanationMd: N,Q form a consecutive block and P follows N. The valid orders are N,Q,R,P; N,Q,P,R is excluded because R is last; R,N,Q,P also works. N,Q cannot occupy3,4 because P then has no later available position. Thus P is last while either N or R can be first.

distractorRationale.last-b: N must precede Q and P.
distractorRationale.last-c: If Q were fourth,N would be third and P could not follow N in a free later position.
distractorRationale.last-d: The premise explicitly excludes R from fourth.
